upgrade.title: Upgrade this session to a team
upgrade.intro: This session becomes the team's coordinator. Its conversation, working directory and sharing are kept; from the next message on it delegates the work to agents and tracks it on the team page.

errors.TEAM_ALREADY: This session is already a team coordinator.

errors.TEAM_PROJECT_CHANGED: The project's directory or default branch changed meanwhile. Try again.

disband.title: Disband this team?
disband.confirm: The team's work items and its activity history are deleted. The coordinator's session and its conversation are kept and continue as an ordinary session; branches are not touched.
disband.done: Team disbanded; its session is kept

errors.TEAM_HAS_LIVE_WORK: The team still has unfinished work items or work items holding a worktree. Finish, cancel or clean them up first.
errors.NARRATOR_EXECUTION_BUSY: The coordinator is running or waiting. Try again once it is idle.

empty.title: Work items show up here
empty.body: The coordinator splits the goal into work items, one branch each, each done by a worker. When one needs your approval, an answer or acceptance, it shows at the top under “Waiting on you”.
empty.placeholderDoing: What the worker is doing · lines changed

wrapUp.title: No open work items
wrapUp.bodyMerged: {{count}} branches are merged into {{base}}. To keep going, tell the coordinator on the left; if the team is done, archive it (every record is kept, read-only) or disband it.
wrapUp.body: Every work item is finished. To keep going, tell the coordinator on the left; if the team is done, archive it (every record is kept, read-only) or disband it.
wrapUp.held: {{count}} finished items still hold their worktree, so the team cannot be disbanded yet: ask the coordinator to clean them up (you approve each cleanup), or archive the team.

start.title: Tell the coordinator what this team should get done
start.body: Say the goal and the constraints. The coordinator splits it into work items, one branch each, and hands them to workers.

examples.upgrade: Upgrade a dependency to its new major version and drop the old compatibility code; one branch per step, reviewed before merging.
examples.issues: Go through the issues labelled bug: fix what can be fixed, and explain in the issue what can't.
examples.tests: Add unit tests to the modules under server/ that have none, up to 80% coverage.

drawer.loadFailed: Could not load this work item.
drawer.filesMore: More files changed than listed here
drawer.diffUnavailable: The changes can't be read now
drawer.findingsClipped: The findings are too long in all; this round is not shown in full
drawer.barNote: Return sends the item back to its worker. Once it is reviewed and marked ready, it can be merged into {{base}}.
drawer.returnHint: The coordinator passes the reason to the worker; the item goes back to “In progress”.
drawer.returnedNotDelivered: Returned, but the coordinator could not be told; tell it in the conversation.

errors.TEAM_WORK_ITEM_NOT_RETURNABLE: Only an item in review or ready to merge can be returned; it has moved on meanwhile.
errors.TEAM_WORK_ITEM_CHANGED: The item changed meanwhile; look again and return it if it still needs it.
errors.TEAM_ARCHIVED: The team is archived; nothing can change. Restore it first.

drawer.dependentsMore: More items depend on it than listed here

workStart.label: New work items start from
workStart.description: Where each new work item's branch begins, and what syncing the base brings in. origin/<base> is fetched into the remote-tracking branch only; your local branch and working tree stay as they are.

marks.worktree: Finished but still holds its worktree; the coordinator can clean it up

page.readOnlyStart: Nobody has given the coordinator a goal yet.

merge.barNote: NarraFork makes a merge commit without touching anyone's working tree. Where {{base}} is checked out, the merge waits for you to fast-forward it.
merge.commandHint: Or run this there yourself; the item is marked merged once its branch is in the base.
merge.confirmText: This moves {{base}} to the prepared merge in {{path}} and updates these files in that working tree. Your own uncommitted changes stay; if one is in the way, git refuses and nothing changes. Hooks do not run.
merge.terminalsWarning_one: A NarraFork terminal is open in that directory.
merge.terminalsWarning_other: {{count}} NarraFork terminals are open in that directory.
merge.confirmFilesMore: More files change than are listed here.
merge.conflictsMore: More files conflict than are listed here.
merge.conflictHint: Nothing was changed. The worker brings the base into its branch and resolves them; the coordinator was told.
merge.conflictReason:
Merging into {{base}} conflicts in these files. Bring {{base}} into the branch, resolve the conflicts and run the checks:
{{files}}
merge.conflictReasonMore:
Merging into {{base}} conflicts in these files (and more). Bring {{base}} into the branch, resolve the conflicts and run the checks:
{{files}}
merge.prepared: The merge is ready. {{base}} is checked out at {{path}}; NarraFork does not change the files there.

disabled.not_ready: Only a ready item can be merged.
disabled.merging: A merge of this item is running.
disabled.worker_running: Its worker is running; merge once it has stopped.
disabled.github_pending: Origin is on GitHub: these items will merge through a pull request, which is coming soon.
disabled.base_remote: The base {{base}} is a remote-tracking branch; only a local branch can be merged into here.
disabled.git_too_old: git 2.38 or newer is needed to merge without touching a working tree.

blocker.stale: {{base}} moved since the merge was prepared: prepare it again.
blocker.not_on_base: That directory is no longer on {{base}}.
blocker.operation_in_progress: A merge, rebase, cherry-pick or bisect is in progress there.
blocker.local_config: That checkout has filters or a hooks directory of its own: run the command yourself.
blocker.unreadable: That directory could not be checked.

errors.TEAM_WORK_ITEM_NOT_READY: Only a ready item can be merged; it changed meanwhile.
errors.TEAM_WORK_ITEM_MERGING: A merge of this item is already running.
errors.TEAM_WORK_ITEM_WORKER_RUNNING: Its worker is running; merge once it has stopped.
errors.TEAM_MERGE_GITHUB_PENDING: Origin is on GitHub: these items will merge through a pull request, which is coming soon.
errors.TEAM_MERGE_BASE_REMOTE: The base is a remote-tracking branch; only a local branch can be merged into here.
errors.TEAM_MERGE_NOT_PREPARED: There is no prepared merge any more: merge again.
errors.TEAM_ARCHIVED: The team is archived. Unarchive it first.
errors.TEAM_MERGE_BASE_MOVED: The base kept moving while the merge was computed. Try again.
errors.TEAM_WORK_ITEM_HEAD_MOVED: The branch moved after the item was marked ready. Have the coordinator review it and mark it ready again.
errors.TEAM_WORK_ITEM_HEAD_UNAVAILABLE: The item has no recorded branch or head to merge. Have the coordinator mark it ready again.
errors.TEAM_MERGE_GIT_TOO_OLD: git 2.38 or newer is needed to merge without touching a working tree.
errors.TEAM_MERGE_STALE: The base moved since the merge was prepared: prepare it again.
errors.TEAM_MERGE_CHECKOUT_BLOCKED: That directory cannot be fast-forwarded now: run the command yourself, or try again.
errors.TEAM_MERGE_CHECKOUT_BUSY: Sessions are running in that directory. Try again once they stop.
errors.TEAM_MERGE_FAST_FORWARD_REFUSED: git refused to fast-forward there because of local changes; nothing changed.
errors.TEAM_MERGE_IDENTITY_UNKNOWN: No git identity to commit the merge with: set yours in Settings, or the host's git user.name and user.email.
errors.GIT_WORKSPACE_BUSY: git is busy in that directory. Try again shortly.
